paper.title_en: The Bondi dipole in full numerical relativity: a self-accelerating positive-negative mass binary
paper.abstract_en: Bondi showed in 1957 that a body of negative active gravitational mass and a positive one should accelerate together without limit while their total momentum stays zero. We test this prediction in full 3+1 numerical relativity, from constraint-satisfying initial data. The matter is two complex scalar fields with identical self-interactions, one of which enters the Einstein equations with the opposite sign; its stars have positive inertial and passive masses but negative active and Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) masses. To our knowledge, they are the first asymptotically flat bodies of negative ADM mass evolved in numerical relativity. A pair of stars with equal and opposite ADM masses accelerates as a single object at constant separation, and its total momentum stays zero to within 0.5%. The acceleration follows Newton's law of gravitation in both mass and separation, reverses when the stars are exchanged, and is absent in same-sign pairs and isolated stars. We detect no gravitational radiation. The results hold for head-on pairs released from rest, up to a few percent of the speed of light, and in the longest run the pair reaches a tenth of it with both stars intact.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在全 3+1 数值相对论中检验 Bondi 1957 年关于正负主动引力质量对自我加速的预测，首次演化出渐近平直且 ADM 质量为负的天体，并检验加速度对质量与间距的牛顿式依赖、动量守恒（0.5% 内）及无引力辐射等定性特征；理论深度与方法严谨性信号强，结果清晰且带有定量限定，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 完整数值相对论中的 Bondi 偶极：一个自我加速的正负质量双星
decision.abstract_zh: Bondi 在 1957 年指出，一个具有负主动引力质量的物体和一个具有正主动引力质量的物体应当无限制地一起加速，而它们的总动量保持为零。我们在完整的 3+1 数值相对论中、从满足约束的初始数据出发检验这一预言。物质是两个具有相同自相互作用的复标量场，其中一个场以相反符号进入 Einstein 方程；其星体具有正惯性质量与正被动质量，但具有负的主动质量与负的 Arnowitt-Deser-Misner（ADM）质量。据我们所知，它们是在数值相对论中被演化的首批渐近平直且具有负 ADM 质量的天体。一对具有相等且相反 ADM 质量的星体作为一个单一物体以恒定间距加速，其总动量在 0.5% 以内保持为零。该加速度在质量和间距两方面都遵循牛顿万有引力定律，在交换两颗星体后反向，并且在同号配对和孤立星体情形下不存在。我们没有探测到引力辐射。这些结果对从静止释放的正面碰撞配对成立，速度可达光速的百分之几，而在最长的一次运行中，该配对达到光速的十分之一，且两颗星体均保持完整。
